title: Weak third-party vendor security requirements
description: Fazio Mechanical had no enterprise-grade endpoint protection and reportedly used only a free antivirus tool, yet held credentials into a portal connected to Target's internal network.

title: Insufficient network segmentation
description: The vendor portal, corporate network, and POS/cardholder data environment were not adequately isolated (flat or weakly segmented network), letting attackers pivot from a billing system into store POS systems.

title: No two-factor authentication on vendor portal
description: Single-factor (password-only) authentication protected an externally reachable vendor portal, so stolen credentials alone were sufficient for access.

title: Un-actioned security alerts
description: FireEye alerts describing the malware activity were generated during the intrusion window but were not escalated or investigated in time, despite the tooling functioning as intended.

title: Unencrypted card data in POS memory
description: Card track data existed briefly in plaintext in POS system memory before encryption, which the RAM-scraping malware was specifically built to exploit.

title: Outbound traffic not adequately monitored
description: Large, unusual outbound transfers to external FTP servers were not flagged or blocked, enabling exfiltration to proceed over multiple days.
cwe: CWE-200 (Exposure of Sensitive Information) / Egress Filtering Gap
